interest_rate.label: Interest rate
interest_rate.plain: The extra amount the lender charges, as a percentage of what you borrowed

emi.label: EMI
emi.plain: Equal Monthly Instalment — the fixed amount you pay every month

net_worth.label: Net worth
net_worth.plain: Everything you own minus everything you owe

sip.label: SIP
sip.plain: Systematic Investment Plan — investing a fixed amount regularly

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.plain: The collection of investments you hold

premium.label: Premium
premium.plain: The amount you pay for your insurance policy

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.plain: The maximum amount the insurer will pay out

liability.label: Liability
liability.plain: Money you owe to someone else

asset.label: Asset
asset.plain: Something you own that has value
